sources.entry: markdown-quicklook - Quick Look plugin for rendered Markdown previews with syntax highlighting. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ruspg/markdown-quicklook) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
markdown-quicklook - Rendered Markdown Quick Look preview with syntax highlighting, YAML front matter, configurable fonts/colors, and a menu bar toggle.

summary.one_liner: A macOS build wrapper that adds rendered Markdown with syntax highlighting to Quick Look previews, built on the PreviewMarkdown extensions by smittytone.
summary.what_it_does: Makes pressing Space on a .md file in Finder show a rendered preview instead of plain source. The README says it applies a GitHub-style "Compact" theme with Helvetica Neue body text, Menlo code, a measured column width, and automatic light and dark pages. Rendering is done by building an NSAttributedString and laying it out with TextKit, not by a WebView or CSS. A companion menu bar app, QLToggle, switches Markdown rendering on or off for both the preview and thumbnail extensions, shows extension status via pluginkit, offers Launch at Login, and can restart Quick Look. The build script clones the upstream PreviewMarkdown submodule, applies a patch layer to a clean checkout, verifies the patches by outcome, and builds ad-hoc signed apps into ~/Applications. The README also mentions YAML front matter and configurable fonts and colours in the host app's Settings.
use_cases: preview markdown files in Finder without opening an editor
rendered Quick Look preview for .md documents
toggle between rendered and plain-text Markdown previews on macOS
build a local Quick Look Markdown plugin from source
customise Quick Look fonts and colours for Markdown reading
stack: Xcode (full install required for source builds)
notable: Patch layer applied to a clean submodule checkout, with 74 outcome-based assertions in the build (68 in one section of the README)
No CSS or WebView in the render path; theme is built from Swift attributes and paragraph styles
QLToggle menu bar app toggles Previewer and Thumbnailer extensions together
Universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel, one-line installer that pins versions optionally
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later; source builds need a full Xcode install, not only command line tools
Builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so downloaded copies need quarantine cleared
Thumbnails look plainer than previews and the qlmanage thumbnail channel is hard to drive from scripts
summary.license: MIT for QLToggle, the build and test scripts, and the patch layer; PreviewMarkdown itself is under its upstream license
